scope: Only the §2.2 PGP + PBDI example, the one mix whose actual masses the review notes list; other polymer types and loadings, and all rheology results, are not transcribed. Acid-activated system.

gaps: The reported 2.5 wt% PBDI target is relative to the acidic polymer solution, not to metakaolin; the explicit masses are kept instead of a percentage.
The 9 M figure is phosphoric acid molarity (acid activation, outside the alkaline recipe-transfer model); no hydroxide-molarity parameter is entered for it.
No stock water fraction or acid-to-sodium substitution is inferred from the stock-solution mass.
Other rigid (0.1, 0.25, 0.5 wt%) and semi-flexible loadings are unlabelled levels and are not transcribed; no rheology or nanoindentation values are in the notes.
